parameters.query: SELECT a.*, p.first_name as patient_first_name, p.last_name as patient_last_name, p.email as patient_email, p.phone as patient_phone, pr.first_name as provider_first_name, pr.last_name as provider_last_name, pr.email as provider_email FROM appointments a JOIN patients p ON a.patient_id = p.patient_id JOIN providers pr ON a.provider_id = pr.provider_id WHERE a.appointment_id = '={{$json.appointmentId}}' AND a.appointment_type = 'telemedicine'

parameters.subject: Your Telemedicine Appointment - Brainsait Healthcare
